ana: Quick kickoff for 'SparkRef' Plan: tiny OSS refapp (chat+embeds), 20m webinar, reproducible bench, gated playbook. Target 500 signups, 100 live.

pete: Dates?

ana: Publish Aug 14, webinar Aug 28. Drafts by Jul 30.

maria: Bench plan: cpu / small-gpu / q4 quant. I'll run p50/p95 and $/1k tokens; need canonical prompts (support convo + short doc).

ana: Repo must be minimal: api+demo, docker, one-click deploy, README quickstart ≤10 lines. Add CONTRIBUTING for bench PRs.

pete: Lead form: name/email/company/role + "Interested in Dedicated" checkbox → AE routing. UTM: campaign=sparkref.

maria: I'll publish CSV and a short methods appendix. Bench runs Jul 20-24.

anA: Social TL;DR: one sentence + emoji. devrel-bot: checklist created https://ok.redwood/launch/sparkref

ana: Owners: ana (launch), pete (repo+forms), maria (bench). Next check-in Jul 5. :rocket:
